notes.title: Smoother gamepad controls + UX improvements + Bug fixes
notes.content:
Patch notes:
[olist]
 Smoother gamepad aiming
 Slow-mo during aiming to make it easier
 Some issues with gamepad controls not showing on tutorials fixed.
 Default gamepad bindings reworked.
 Gamepad icons are now more readable.
 Menus are now fully navigable with the gamepad
 Menus are more readable when using gamepad.
 Issue where sound would occasionally vanish after playing for a while fixed.
 Better tutorials.
 Levels reordered for a smoother experience.
 Steam achievement popups now show immediately instead of on game quit.
[/olist]
Slow-mo in action:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657351/46170db2bb920524daefee26b385f06cb35e4cfa.gif

notes.title: Control:Override ver 1.1.0: Japanese translation added and some bug fixes
notes.content:
Full patch notes:
1. The game is now fully playable in Japanese
2. Fixed a bug that prevented players from going to the rewind menu from the pause menu.

notes.title: Control:Override ver 1.06: 32-bit version added and some UX improvements
notes.content:
Full patch notes:
1. Can now transfer powers attached from one platform to another without needing to remove it first.
2. 32-bit version added.
3. Some crash fixes.
4. Demo is now fully playable in Japanese.
5. Better selection of demo levels.

The game should automatically download the 32-bit version if your device needs it. If you face any issues, please post in the steam forums.

notes.title: Control : Override has now been released!
